#Histogram fo key parameters
```{r}
x_expression <- expression(R^2)
#title <- Histogram~of~R^2
a<- ggplot(pc, aes(x = R2)) +       # Modify color around bars
  geom_histogram(col = "black", fill="white")+
  labs(x=x_expression, y="Frequency", size=8)+
   #(color = "red", size = 1)+
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept=mean(R2, na.rm=T)), 
               color="blue", linetype="dashed", size=0.5)+
  theme_classic()
a<- a + theme(text = element_text(size = 12))  
a
```

```{r}
# Save the plot
ggsave(filename = "hist_r2.png", plot = a, path = "C:\\Users\\p739b253\\OneDrive - University of Kansas\\FEWtures\\Manuscript2\\IMAGES\\LR_KS")
```




``` {r}

  geom_histogram(col = "black", fill="white")+
  labs(x=x_expression, y="Frequency")+
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept=mean(Qred, na.rm=T)), 
               color="blue", linetype="dashed", size=0.5)+
  theme_classic() 
d<- d + theme(text = element_text(size = 12))  
d
```

########### CHECKING FOR NON-NUMERIC IN DATA, AND NA's


```{r}
str(a)  # Check the structure of the result
```
```{r}
sapply(r, class)
r[] <- lapply(r, function(x) if(is.factor(x) || is.character(x)) as.numeric(as.factor(x)) else x)
```

```{r}
colSums(is.na(r))
```
```{r}
r <- na.omit(r)  # Remove rows with missing values
# OR use pairwise correlation calculation:
a <- cor(r, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
```

```{r}
r <- r[, sapply(r, function(x) length(unique(x)) > 1)]
```

```{r}
library(corrplot)
corrplot(a, method = "color")

#install.packages("ggcorrplot")
library(ggcorrplot)
ggcorrplot(a)
```






```{r}
a <- a<- corr_coef(r)
plot(a)
```
